title: Release run script + pre-release checklist for the demo
description: Produce board/run.sh (executable; starts the board with BOARD_PORT default 8765, exec python3 board/server.py from script dir) and board/docs/release-checklist.md (items + the exact command/output for each: python compile check, unittest suite, /api/tasks 200, /api/stats 200, offline/no-deps confirmation). Verify by starting the server on a scratch port (BOARD_PORT=8899), curling both endpoints, then killing it — retry once if the file is being edited concurrently, mark blocked if still failing. NOTE: port 8765 is occupied by the live demo server; do not touch it. Governing skill: skills/sdlc/sdlc-release/SKILL.md.
